articles.title_en: Iterative distributed multinomial regression
articles.title_cn: 迭代分布式多项回归
articles.abstract_en: This article introduces an iterative distributed computing (IDC) estimator for the multinomial logistic regression model with large choice sets. The IDC estimator reformulates the estimation problem as a sequence of structured, low-dimensional subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We establish that, when initialized with a consistent estimator, the IDC estimator is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator and achieves asymptotic efficiency under a weak dominance condition. We further develop a parametric bootstrap procedure for inference based on the IDC estimator and prove its consistency. Extensive simulation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and highlight the computational efficiency of the IDC estimator.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有大选择集的多项逻辑回归模型，引入了一种迭代分布式计算（IDC）估计量。IDC估计量将估计问题重新表述为一系列结构化、低维的子问题，这些子问题可以高效且并行地求解。我们证明，当以一致估计量初始化时，IDC估计量渐近等价于最大似然估计量，并在弱支配条件下达到渐近有效性。我们进一步基于IDC估计量开发了一种参数自助法程序用于推断，并证明了其一致性。大量模拟研究验证了所提方法的有效性，并突出了IDC估计量的计算效率。

articles.title_en: Principal component analysis for a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables
articles.title_cn: 针对平稳与非平稳变量混合的主成分分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a procedure for uncovering the common cyclical factors that drive a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables. The method does not require knowing which variables are nonstationary or the nature of the nonstationarity. An application to the FRED-MD macroeconomic dataset demonstrates that the approach offers similar benefits to those oftraditional principal component analysis with some added advantages.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种程序，用于揭示驱动平稳与非平稳变量混合的共同周期性因素。该方法不需要知道哪些变量是非平稳的，也不需要知道非平稳的性质。对FRED-MD宏观经济数据集的应用表明，该方法提供了与传统主成分分析相似的益处，并具有一些额外的优势。

articles.title_en: Normal approximation for U-statistics with cross-sectional dependence
articles.title_cn: 具有截面依赖性的U统计量的正态近似
articles.abstract_en: We establish normal approximation in the Wasserstein metric for both non-degenerate and degenerate second-order U-statistics under cross-sectional dependence using Stein’s method. For the non-degenerate case, our results extend recent studies on the asymptotic properties of sums of cross-sectionally dependent random variables. The degenerate case is more challenging due to the additional dependence induced by the nonlinearity of the U-statistic kernel. Through a specific implementation of Stein’s method, we derive convergence rates under conditions on the mixing rate, the sparsity of the cross-sectional dependence structure, and the moments of the U-statistic kernel. Finally, we demonstrate the application of our theoretical results with a nonparametric specification test for data with cross-sectional dependence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用Stein方法，在截面依赖下，为既非退化也退化的二阶U统计量建立了Wasserstein度量下的正态近似。对于非退化情形，我们的结果扩展了近期关于截面依赖随机变量和的渐近性质的研究。退化情形更具挑战性，因为U统计量核的非线性引入了额外的依赖性。通过Stein方法的一种具体实现，我们在混合速率、截面依赖结构的稀疏性以及U统计量核的矩的条件下推导出了收敛速率。最后，我们通过一个针对具有截面依赖性数据的非参数设定检验，展示了我们理论结果的应用。

articles.title_en: Multivariate inference for dynamic systemic risk measures
articles.title_cn: 动态系统性风险度量的多元推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides statistical inference for marginal expected shortfall (MES) and delta conditional value-at-risk (ΔCoVaR) measures, which are semiparametrically estimated by a two-step procedure in a multivariate GARCH-type framework. We establish the asymptotic properties of corresponding estimators and illustrate how the estimation uncertainty can be decomposed into dynamic univariate marginal and time-varying dependence components. Our methodology reveals good finite sample performance for estimation and prediction of risk. Moreover, we propose tests for differences in systemic risk in order to construct confidence sets for companies’ ranks in systemic risk rankings. In an empirical application based on 50 large US financial institutions, our framework provides novel evidence on the informativeness of such rankings. Moreover, our findings highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying return dependence in systemic risk estimators.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为边际预期损失（MES）和增量条件在险价值（ΔCoVaR）度量提供统计推断，这些度量通过多元GARCH类框架中的两步程序进行半参数估计。我们建立了相应估计量的渐近性质，并说明估计不确定性如何分解为动态单变量边际成分和时变相依成分。我们的方法在风险估计和预测方面展现出良好的有限样本表现。此外，我们提出了系统性风险差异的检验，以构建公司在系统性风险排名中排名的置信集。在基于50家大型美国金融机构的实证应用中，我们的框架为此类排名的信息含量提供了新证据。此外，我们的发现强调了在系统性风险估计量中考虑时变收益相依性的重要性。

articles.title_en: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
articles.title_cn: 潜在多维聚类：推断与实践
articles.abstract_en: We show how clustering standard errors in one or more dimensions can be justified in M-estimation when there is sampling or assignment uncertainty. Since existing procedures for variance estimation are either conservative or invalid, we propose a variance estimator that refines a conservative procedure and remains valid. We then interpret environments where clustering is frequently employed in empirical work from our design-based perspective and provide insights on their estimands and inference procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了在存在抽样或分配不确定性时，如何在M估计中为一个或多个维度上的聚类标准误提供依据。由于现有的方差估计程序要么保守要么无效，我们提出了一种方差估计量，它改进了保守程序并保持有效。然后，我们从基于设计的视角解释了实证工作中经常采用聚类的环境，并就其估计目标和推断程序提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Spatio-temporal autoregressions for high dimensional matrix-valued time series
articles.title_cn: 高维矩阵值时间序列的时空自回归
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by predicting intraday trading volume curves, we consider two spatio-temporal autoregressive models for matrix time series, in which each column may represent daily trading volume curve of one asset, and each row captures synchronized 5-minute volume intervals across multiple assets. While traditional matrix time series focus mainly on temporal evolution, our approach incorporates both spatial and temporal dynamics, enabling simultaneous analysis of interactions across multiple dimensions. The inherent endogeneity in spatio-temporal autoregressive models renders ordinary least squares estimation inconsistent. To overcome this difficulty while simultaneously estimating two distinct weight matrices with banded structure, we develop an iterated generalized Yule-Walker estimator by adapting a generalized method of moments framework based on Yule-Walker equations. Moreover, unlike conventional models that employ a single bandwidth parameter, the dual-bandwidth specification in our framework requires a new two-step, ratio-based sequential estimation procedure.
articles.abstract_cn: 受预测日内交易量曲线的启发，我们考虑了两个矩阵时间序列的时空自回归模型，其中每一列可以表示一种资产的日交易量曲线，每一行捕捉多个资产同步的5分钟交易量区间。传统矩阵时间序列主要关注时间演化，而我们的方法同时纳入了空间和时间动态，使得能够同时分析多个维度之间的交互作用。时空自回归模型中的内在内生性导致普通最小二乘估计不一致。为了在同时估计两个具有带状结构的不同权重矩阵时克服这一困难，我们通过基于Yule-Walker方程的广义矩方法框架，开发了一种迭代广义Yule-Walker估计量。此外，与采用单一带宽参数的传统模型不同，我们框架中的双带宽设定需要一种新的基于比率的两步序贯估计程序。

articles.title_en: Robust inference for time varying predictability: A Sieve-IVX approach
articles.title_cn: 时变可预测性的稳健推断：一种Sieve-IVX方法
articles.abstract_en: Predictive regression models are often used to evaluate the predictive capability of economic fundamentals on bond and equity returns. Inferential procedures in these regressions typically employ parameter constancy or piecewise constancy in slope coefficients. Such formulations are prone to misspecification, more especially during periods of disturbance or evolution in prevailing economic and financial conditions, which can lead to size distortion and spurious evidence of predictability. To address these issues the present work proposes a semiparametric predictive regression model with mixed-root regressors and time-varying coefficients that allow for smooth evolution in the generating mechanism over time. For estimation and inference a novel variant of the self-generated instrument approach called sieve-IVX is introduced, giving a robust approach to inference concerning time-varying predictability that is applicable irrespective of the degrees of persistence. Asymptotic theory of the Sieve-IVX approach is based on a new infinite dimensional invariance principle that delivers limit theory for sieve-IVX estimation, validating pointwise and uniform inference procedures for testing predictability and model specification. Simulations show excellent performance characteristics of the resulting tests in finite samples. An empirical exercise is conducted examining excess S&P 500 returns, applying Sieve-IVX regression with pointwise and uniform tests to reveal evidence of time-varying patterns in the predictive capability of commonly used fundamental variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 预测回归模型常用于评估经济基本面因素对债券和股票收益的预测能力。这些回归中的推断程序通常采用斜率系数的参数恒定性或分段恒定性。此类设定容易产生设定误差，尤其是在 prevailing 经济和金融条件发生扰动或演变期间，这可能导致规模扭曲和可预测性的虚假证据。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种半参数预测回归模型，该模型包含混合根回归量和时变系数，允许生成机制随时间平滑演变。为进行估计和推断，引入了一种称为sieve-IVX的自生成工具变量方法的新变体，提供了一种关于时变可预测性的稳健推断方法，无论持久程度如何均适用。Sieve-IVX方法的渐近理论基于一个新的无限维不变性原理，该原理为sieve-IVX估计提供了极限理论，验证了用于检验可预测性和模型设定的逐点和一致推断程序。模拟显示所得检验在有限样本中具有优异的性能特征。进行了一项实证练习，检验S&P 500的超额收益，应用Sieve-IVX回归与逐点和一致检验，揭示了常用基本面变量预测能力中时变模式的证据。

articles.title_en: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
articles.title_cn: 通过离散傅里叶变换检验具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型中的结构变化
articles.abstract_en: We propose a discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based test for detecting structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects (IFE). When structural changes are present but ignored, the conventional asymptotic distribution of the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) may no longer provide reliable inference, and the resulting residuals contain signals of parameter instability. Our test exploits this feature by comparing the DFT of weighted residuals to the flat (zero) spectrum implied under the null hypothesis of no structural change. We establish the theoretical properties of the test, including its asymptotic null distribution and its local and global power, and propose a bootstrap procedure for valid inference in finite samples. Notably, the proposed test can detect a class of local alternatives converging to the null at the rate of N−1/2T−1/2, matching the convergence rate of the slope estimators, where N and T are the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed test across various types of structural changes in both factor loadings and slope coefficients. We further illustrate the empirical relevance of our method by applying it to the environmental Kuznets curve and the relationship between health expenditure and income. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for structural changes in panel data models with IFE.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的检验，用于检测具有交互固定效应（IFE）的面板数据模型中的结构变化。当结构变化存在但被忽略时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量的常规渐近分布可能不再提供可靠的推断，并且由此产生的残差包含参数不稳定的信号。我们的检验利用这一特征，通过将加权残差的DFT与无结构变化原假设下隐含的平坦（零）谱进行比较。我们建立该检验的理论性质，包括其渐近原分布及其局部和全局功效，并提出一种用于有限样本中有效推断的bootstrap程序。值得注意的是，所提出的检验能够检测一类以N−1/2T−1/2的速率收敛到原假设的局部备择假设，与斜率估计量的收敛速率相匹配，其中N和T分别为横截面维度和时间维度。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的检验在因子载荷和斜率系数中各种类型的结构变化下均具有优异表现。我们进一步通过将其应用于环境库兹涅茨曲线以及卫生支出与收入之间的关系，来说明我们方法的经验相关性。我们的发现凸显了在具有IFE的面板数据模型中考虑结构变化的重要性。

articles.title_en: Matrix-valued spatial autoregressions with dynamic heterogeneous spillovers
articles.title_cn: 具有动态异质性溢出的矩阵值空间自回归
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a new time-varying parameter spatial matrix autoregressive model that integrates matrix-valued time series, heterogeneous spillover effects, outlier robustness, and time-varying parameters in one unified framework. The model allows for separate dynamic spatial spillover effects across both the row and column dimensions of the matrix-valued observations. Robustness can be introduced via a matrix Student’s t distribution. The model can still be estimated straightforwardly by standard maximum likelihood methods, and we establish stationarity and invertibility of the model, as well as consistency and asymptotic normality of its maximum likelihood estimator. Simulations reveal that the two-way spatial spillover dynamics can be successfully recovered even if the model is misspecified. Using a 12 × 12 trade network application, we show that the time-varying, robust matrix features of the new model better fit the empirical data than alternative specifications.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入一个新的时变参数空间矩阵自回归模型，该模型将矩阵值时间序列、异质性溢出效应、异常值稳健性和时变参数整合在一个统一框架中。该模型允许在矩阵值观测的行和列维度上分别存在动态空间溢出效应。稳健性可以通过矩阵Student's t分布引入。该模型仍然可以通过标准最大似然方法直接估计，我们建立了模型的平稳性和可逆性，以及其最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。模拟表明，即使模型被错误设定，双向空间溢出动态也可以被成功恢复。使用一个12 × 12贸易网络应用，我们表明新模型的时变、稳健矩阵特征比替代设定更好地拟合经验数据。

articles.title_en: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
articles.title_cn: 非可加固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？
articles.abstract_en: Panel or grouped data are often used to allow for unobserved individual heterogeneity in econometric models via fixed effects. In this paper, we discuss identification of a panel data model in which the unobserved heterogeneity both enters additively and interacts with treatment variables. We present identification and estimation methods for parameters of interest in this model under both strict and weak exogeneity assumptions. The key identification insight is that other periods’ treatment variables are instruments for the unobserved fixed effects. We apply our proposed estimator to matched student-teacher data used to estimate value-added models of teacher quality. We show that the common assumption that the return to teacher quality is the same for all students is rejected by the data. We also present evidence that No Child Left Behind-era school accountability raised the effectiveness of teacher quality for lower performing students.
articles.abstract_cn: 面板数据或分组数据常被用于通过固定效应来允许计量经济学模型中的不可观测个体异质性。在本文中，我们讨论了一个面板数据模型的识别问题，其中不可观测异质性既以可加方式进入，又与处理变量交互。我们在严格外生性和弱外生性假设下，提出了该模型中感兴趣参数的识别和估计方法。关键的识别洞见是，其他时期的处理变量是未观测固定效应的工具变量。我们将所提出的估计量应用于匹配的学生-教师数据，这些数据用于估计教师质量的增值模型。我们表明，教师质量回报对所有学生都相同这一常见假设被数据拒绝。我们还提供了证据表明，《不让一个孩子掉队》时代的学校问责制提高了教师质量对表现较差学生的有效性。

articles.title_en: Testing asset pricing factor models: An out-of-sample perspective
articles.title_cn: 检验资产定价因子模型：一个样本外视角
articles.abstract_en: We develop the Sample Splitting Alpha (SSA) test, a formal out-of-sample (OOS) test for evaluating whether an asset pricing factor model satisfies the zero-alpha restriction in high-dimensional settings. The test uses sample splitting to separate portfolio weight estimation from model evaluation and ridge regularization to stabilize the portfolio problem when the number of test assets is large. We show that each single SSA statistic is asymptotically Gaussian under mild regularity conditions. For the aggregated SSA statistic used in implementation, we characterize the dependence across split statistics and compute p-values by resampling. Economically, the statistic relates to the OOS incremental spanning value of the chosen test assets relative to a candidate factor model, measured by the OOS squared information ratio. The simulation results accord with the asymptotic analysis. In empirical applications, SSA rejects some statistically constructed factor models more often than the in-sample benchmarks, despite those models’ strong in-sample fit.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了样本分割Alpha（SSA）检验，这是一种正式样本外（OOS）检验，用于在高维设定中评估资产定价因子模型是否满足零Alpha约束。该检验使用样本分割将投资组合权重估计与模型评估分离，并使用岭正则化在检验资产数量较大时稳定投资组合问题。我们证明，在温和正则条件下，每个单一SSA统计量渐近服从高斯分布。对于实施中使用的聚合SSA统计量，我们刻画了各分割统计量之间的依赖性，并通过重抽样计算p值。在经济意义上，该统计量与所选检验资产相对于候选因子模型的OOS增量跨度价值相关，由OOS平方信息比率衡量。模拟结果与渐近分析一致。在实证应用中，尽管一些统计构造的因子模型具有强样本内拟合，SSA比样本内基准更频繁地拒绝这些模型。

articles.title_en: High dimensional alpha test for linear factor pricing model with L q -norm
articles.title_cn: 基于L q 范数的高维线性因子定价模型alpha检验
articles.abstract_en: We consider testing zero pricing errors in high-dimensional linear factor pricing models. Existing methods are mainly based on either an L2 statistic, which is effective under dense alternatives, or an L∞ statistic, which is powerful under very sparse alternatives. To bridge these two regimes, we develop a class of Lq-based tests for finite q, including the practically useful L4 and L6 cases. We show that larger q leads to greater sensitivity to sparse alternatives. We further establish the asymptotic independence between the L∞ statistic and the Lq statistic for any finite q, which motivates a Cauchy combination test that adapts to a broad range of sparsity levels. Simulation studies and a real-data analysis show that the proposed methods are more robust to the unknown sparsity of the alternative and can outperform existing procedures in finite samples.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑检验高维线性因子定价模型中的零定价误差。现有方法主要基于在稠密备择假设下有效的L2统计量，或基于在非常稀疏备择假设下具有高功效的L∞统计量。为衔接这两种情形，我们发展了一类基于Lq的检验，适用于有限q，包括实际中常用的L4和L6情形。我们表明，较大的q导致对稀疏备择假设更敏感。我们进一步建立了L∞统计量与任意有限q的Lq统计量之间的渐近独立性，这启发了一种适用于广泛稀疏水平的Cauchy组合检验。模拟研究和实际数据分析表明，所提方法对未知的备择假设稀疏性更为稳健，并在有限样本中能够优于现有方法。

articles.title_en: Panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects
articles.title_cn: 具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的面板阈值回归
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a new approach to estimation and inference in multiple regime panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects. Such effects are practically relevant and have features that distinguish them from traditional linear panel data models. It is shown that within-regime demeaning in the static model or within-regime first-differencing in the dynamic model both fail to deliver consistent threshold estimators. Instead, correlated random effects models are suggested to address endogeneity in such panel threshold systems. The paper develops a unified framework of estimation and inference for both static and dynamic models that applies irrespective of whether the unobserved individual-specific threshold effects exist or whether the number of regimes is correctly specified. The approach involves model selection based on sequential testing which allows for underestimation of the number of regimes, develops asymptotic theory for least squares estimation that is robust to such model misspecification, and proposes new inferential methods for the model parameters which have improved asymptotic and empirical properties over existing methods. Simulations combined with an empirical application illustrate the practical utility of the new methodology.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的多机制面板阈值回归中的估计和推断提供了一种新方法。此类效应在实际中具有相关性，并且具有使其区别于传统线性面板数据模型的特征。研究表明，静态模型中的机制内去均值或动态模型中的机制内一阶差分均无法提供一致的阈值估计量。相反，建议采用相关随机效应模型来处理此类面板阈值系统中的内生性。本文为静态和动态模型开发了一个统一的估计和推断框架，该框架无论未观测个体特定阈值效应是否存在，或机制数量是否被正确设定，均适用。该方法涉及基于序贯检验的模型选择，允许对机制数量的低估，为最小二乘估计开发了对这种模型误设稳健的渐近理论，并针对模型参数提出了新的推断方法，这些方法相比现有方法具有改进的渐近和实证性质。模拟结合实证应用说明了新方法的实际效用。

articles.title_en: Measurement error and peer effects in networks
articles.title_cn: 网络中的测量误差与同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: In many practical applications, only noisy proxies for the true regressors are available, which is commonly believed to induce an attenuation bias. In the linear-in-means model, however, estimated peer effects might be inflated, potentially leading to false positives. This paper shows that the asymptotic bias depends on the interplay between individual characteristics and network links and demonstrates how the network structure can facilitate identification without the need for additional external information. Based on these identification results, we present consistent GMM and 2SLS estimators that are easily implementable. Our results are illustrated by means of a Monte Carlo simulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多实际应用中，仅能获得真实回归变量的含噪代理变量，这通常被认为会导致衰减偏误。然而，在线性均值模型中，估计的同伴效应可能被夸大，从而可能导致假阳性。本文表明，渐近偏误取决于个体特征与网络链接之间的相互作用，并展示了网络结构如何能够在无需额外外部信息的情况下促进识别。基于这些识别结果，我们提出了易于实施的一致GMM和2SLS估计量。我们的结果通过蒙特卡洛模拟加以说明。

articles.title_en: Real-time monitoring for stock return predictability in nonstationary volatility environments
articles.title_cn: 非平稳波动率环境下股票收益可预测性的实时监测
articles.abstract_en: Stock return predictability, should it exist, is likely to be episodic in nature. In order to exploit such pockets of predictability it is essential that they are rapidly detected, in real-time, as the nascent predictive regime emerges. This will typically entail the repeated (sequential) application of one-shot end-of-sample predictability statistics, updated as new data become available. Consequently, in addition to dealing with the usual inference problems caused by unknown regressor persistence and predictive regression endogeneity, one must also account for the multiple testing issues inherent in such monitoring procedures. In addition, stock returns and/or the predictors commonly used typically exhibit time-varying volatility and it is known that ignoring such data features can result in the spurious detection of predictability. We propose real-time monitoring procedures which take account of these issues. Our preferred monitoring strategy uses a CUSUM-type procedure based on a specific moment condition related to the predictive power of the putative predictor. We implement nonparametric adjustment methods to allow for the possibility of time-varying volatility which do not require the practitioner to assume any particular parametric model for volatility. Monte Carlo simulations confirm that our proposed detection procedures display well-controlled false positive rates across a range of feasible volatility paths coupled with good power to rapidly detect an emerging predictive episode. The empirical relevance of our proposed monitoring strategy is illustrated in a pseudo real-time monitoring exercise using a well-known dataset of S&P 500 returns.
articles.abstract_cn: 股票收益可预测性，如果存在的话，很可能在本质上是间歇性的。为了利用这些可预测性的窗口，至关重要的是在新生的预测机制出现时，能够实时地迅速检测到它们。这通常需要对一次性样本末端可预测性统计量进行重复（序贯）应用，并随着新数据的可用而更新。因此，除了处理由未知回归变量持续性和预测回归内生性引起的通常推断问题外，还必须考虑此类监测程序中固有的多重检验问题。此外，股票收益和/或常用的预测变量通常表现出时变波动率，并且已知忽略此类数据特征可能导致可预测性的虚假检测。我们提出了考虑这些问题的实时监测程序。我们偏好的监测策略使用基于与假定预测变量预测能力相关的特定矩条件的CUSUM型程序。我们实施非参数调整方法，以允许时变波动率的可能性，而不要求实践者假设任何特定的波动率参数模型。蒙特卡洛模拟证实，我们提出的检测程序在一系列可行的波动率路径上显示出良好控制的假阳性率，同时具有良好的功效来迅速检测新出现的预测期。我们提出的监测策略的经验相关性通过使用著名的S&P 500收益数据集的伪实时监测练习进行了说明。

articles.title_en: Jackknife variance estimators for two-way clustering with serially correlated time effects
articles.title_cn: 具有序列相关时间效应的双向聚类中的刀切方差估计量
articles.abstract_en: Chiang et al. (2024) and Chen and Vogelsang (2024) developed cluster-robust variance estimators (CRVEs) for linear regressions with two-way clustered data allowing for arbitrary serial dependence. However, conventional CRVEs can perform poorly in finite samples. We propose jackknife CRVEs and establish their theoretical validity. Our theoretical and simulation results demonstrate several advantages of the proposed procedures. First, the jackknife CRVE delivers more reliable finite-sample inference than the conventional two-way CRVE. Second, it avoids undefined standard errors arising from non-positive definite CRVEs. Third, in a benchmark setting, it is never downward biased. Finally, when the limiting distribution may be non-Gaussian, the proposed max-jackknife test remains asymptotically conservative.
articles.abstract_cn: Chiang等（2024）以及Chen和Vogelsang（2024）为允许任意序列依赖的双向聚类数据的线性回归开发了聚类稳健方差估计量（CRVEs）。然而，传统CRVEs在有限样本中可能表现不佳。我们提出刀切CRVEs并建立其理论有效性。我们的理论和模拟结果展示了所提出程序的若干优势。第一，刀切CRVE比传统双向CRVE提供更可靠的有限样本推断。第二，它避免了由非正定CRVEs产生的未定义标准误。第三，在一个基准设定中，它从不会向下偏误。最后，当极限分布可能非高斯时，所提出的最大刀切检验保持渐近保守。

articles.title_en: Robust estimation and inference for high-dimensional panel data models
articles.title_cn: 高维面板数据模型的稳健估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the relevant literature with a complete toolkit for conducting robust estimation and inference about the parameters of interest involved in a high-dimensional panel data framework. Specifically, (1) we allow for non-Gaussian, serially and cross-sectionally correlated and heteroskedastic error processes, (2) we develop an estimation method for the high-dimensional long-run covariance matrix using a thresholded estimator, (3) we also allow for the number of regressors to grow faster than the sample size.Methodologically and technically, we develop two Nagaev-type concentration inequalities: one for a partial sum and the other for a quadratic form, subject to a set of easily verifiable conditions. Leveraging these two inequalities, we derive a non-asymptotic bound for the LASSO estimator, achieve asymptotic normality via the node-wise LASSO regression, and establish a sharp convergence rate for the thresholded heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) estimator.We demonstrate the practical relevance of these theoretical results by investigating a high-dimensional panel data model with interactive effects. Moreover, we conduct extensive numerical studies using simulated and real data examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为相关文献提供了一个完整的工具包，用于对高维面板数据框架中涉及的感兴趣参数进行稳健估计和推断。具体而言，(1) 我们允许非高斯、序列相关和横截面相关以及异方差误差过程，(2) 我们使用阈值估计量开发了一种高维长期协方差矩阵的估计方法，(3) 我们还允许回归变量数量增长快于样本量。在方法论和技术上，我们开发了两个Nagaev型集中不等式：一个用于部分和，另一个用于二次型，均在一组易于验证的条件下成立。利用这两个不等式，我们推导了LASSO估计量的非渐近界，通过逐节点LASSO回归实现了渐近正态性，并为阈值异方差和自相关一致（HAC）估计量建立了尖锐的收敛速度。我们通过研究一个具有交互效应的高维面板数据模型来展示这些理论结果的实际相关性。此外，我们使用模拟和真实数据示例进行了广泛的数值研究。

articles.title_en: Panel data models with interactive fixed effects and (relatively) small T
articles.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应和（相对）小T的面板数据模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the estimation of a linear panel data model with interactive fixed effects. A transformation is introduced which, after having been applied, renders the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) consistent and asymptotically unbiased when n is large and T is fixed. This is termed the transformed least squares (TLS) estimator. Going further, these properties are shown to also carry over to the large n, large T setting, provided T/n → 0. This contrasts sharply with the usual case, where the LS estimator is, in general, inconsistent when n is large and T is fixed, and is asymptotically biased when both n and T are large.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有交互固定效应的线性面板数据模型的估计。引入了一种变换，在应用该变换后，当n大且T固定时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量变得一致且渐近无偏。这被称为变换最小二乘（TLS）估计量。进一步，这些性质被证明在n大、T也大的情形下同样成立，只要T/n → 0。这与通常情形形成鲜明对比，在通常情形下，当n大且T固定时，LS估计量一般不一致，而当n和T都大时，则具有渐近偏差。

articles.title_en: Treatment evaluation at the intensive and extensive margins
articles.title_cn: 在集约边际和广延边际上的处理效应评估
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a solution to the evaluation of treatment effects in selective samples when neither instruments nor parametric assumptions are available. We provide sharp bounds for average treatment effects under a conditional monotonicity assumption for all principal strata, i.e. units characterizing the complete intensive and extensive margins. Most importantly, we allow for a large share of units whose selection is indifferent to treatment, e.g. due to non-compliance. The existence of such a population is crucially tied to the regularity of sharp population bounds and thus conventional asymptotic inference for methods such as Lee bounds can be misleading. This problem can be solved using smoothed outer identification regions for inference. We provide semiparametrically efficient debiased machine learning estimators for both regular and smooth bounds that can accommodate high-dimensional covariates and flexible functional forms. Our study of active labor market policy reveals the empirical prevalence of the aforementioned indifference population and supports results from previous impact analyses under much weaker assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为在既无工具变量也无参数假设可用时，选择性样本中处理效应的评估提供了一种解决方案。我们在对所有主层（即刻画完整集约边际和广延边际的单元）的条件单调性假设下，提供了平均处理效应的尖锐界。最重要的是，我们允许存在很大比例的单元，其选择对处理无差异，例如由于不依从。此类总体的存在与尖锐总体界的正则性密切相关，因此诸如Lee界之类方法的传统渐近推断可能产生误导。该问题可通过使用平滑外识别区域进行推断来解决。我们为规则界和平滑界提供了半参数有效的去偏机器学习估计量，能够容纳高维协变量和灵活的函数形式。我们对积极劳动力市场政策的研究揭示了上述无差异总体在经验上的普遍性，并在弱得多的假设下支持了先前影响分析的结果。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric identification of first-price auction with unobserved competition: A density discontinuity framework
articles.title_cn: 未观测竞争下第一价格拍卖的非参数识别：一个密度断点框架
articles.abstract_en: We consider nonparametric identification of independent private value first-price auction models, in which the analyst only observes winning bids. Our benchmark model assumes an exogenous number of bidders N. We show that, if the bidders observe N, the resulting discontinuities in the winning bid density can be used to identify the distribution of N. The private value distribution can be nonparametrically identified in a second step. This extends, under testable identification conditions, to the case where N is a number of potential buyers, who bid with some unknown probability. Identification also holds in presence of additive unobserved heterogeneity drawn from some parametric distributions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑独立私人价值第一价格拍卖模型的非参数识别，其中分析者仅观测到中标出价。我们的基准模型假设投标人数N为外生。我们证明，如果投标人观测到N，则中标出价密度中由此产生的断点可用于识别N的分布。私人价值分布可在第二步中非参数识别。在可检验的识别条件下，这扩展到N为潜在买家数量、他们以某个未知概率投标的情形。在存在来自某些参数分布的加性未观测异质性时，识别同样成立。
